design.options_rotation: Within each proposed-action group, family ordinal modulo 3; identical semantic order in FR/EN. Each split and language has balanced proposed positions.
design.split_policy: First family of each proposed action is calibration; remaining three families are test. Translations stay together.
design.fixture_role: One common synthetic execution recipe; not candidate-visible and not proof of authorization or materialization.
design.independence: Twelve authored task patterns, not twelve independently observed users. Shared labels, scope framing and execution fixture limit generalization.

limitations: Synthetic proposals, not observed usage or human gold.
No prediction or routing output was consulted to assign references.
No model, planner, business read, service or fixture execution was performed.
Counts concern proposed selection only; wrapper output assertions require the separately qualified fixture.
Fallback is a benchmark action, not a promise of implemented abstention/HITL.
Shared fixture is not a holdout corpus; splits isolate task families only.
